scenario: Free talk with a friendly British friend, Kate, about the learner's week and about dates: birthdays, races, holidays. Recycle unit 1: be, questions, this/that, telling the time, and ordinal numbers with months (on the first of May). Very short A1 sentences.
setup_ru: Свободный разговор с Кейт о твоей неделе. Обязательно назови несколько дат: день рождения, забег, праздник.

useful.en: It's on the first of May.
